summary_en: 1,000,000 shares (7.1% of outstanding, ex-treasury) to be acquired via open market between Aug 7, 2026 and Mar 31, 2027; upper limit ¥10.0B. All acquired shares to be cancelled. Funded by excess proceeds from May 2026 SiTime stake sale.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Relating to Treasury Share Acquisition and Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: MegaChips Corporation announced a share buyback authorization on 6 August 2026. The company will acquire up to 1,000,000 ordinary shares (7.1% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) for an aggregate consideration not to exceed ¥10.0 billion via open-market purchases between 7 August 2026 and 31 March 2027. All acquired shares will be cancelled to enhance per-share value and capital efficiency. The company funded this program using excess proceeds from a partial sale of SiTime Corporation shares completed in May 2026, which exceeded the initial plan. Management stated that current share prices trade below levels it considers appropriate, and that share buybacks represent an effective capital-return mechanism when coupled with medium-term growth prospects and market conditions. Cancellation will occur following completion of acquisitions, to be announced separately.
